text: Assumption: In the case of an error (Negative Response), OperationOutput is not instantiated, but an NRC is signaled — is this correct?

assumption: In the case of an error (Negative Response), OperationOutput is not instantiated, but an NRC is signaled.
rationale: [SWS_DM_00632] explicitly restricts the purpose of the structure to positive responses ("positive respose message").
